verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: hoi nimaanaa bhagat kar gurmukh dhraoo har dharasan paiaa|

en.bdb: By becoming humble only, Dhru could behold the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਆਪ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat vachhal hoi bheTiaa maan nimaane aap dhivaiaa|

en.bdb: God, affectionate  to the devotees, also embraced him and egoless Dhruv attained the highest  glory.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਗਾਸਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: maat lok vich mukat kar nihachal vaas agaas chaRaiaa|

en.bdb: In this mortal world he was granted liberation and then a stable  place in the sky was given him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਚਉਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dh sooraj tetees karoR paradhakhanaa chaufer firaiaa|

en.bdb: Moon, sun and all the thirty three crores of angels circumambulate and revolve around him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਵਖਾਣਦੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: vedh puraan vakhaanadhe paragaT kar parataap janaiaa|

en.bdb: His magnificence has  been clearly described in the Vedas and Puranas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: abigat gat at agam hai akath kathaa veechaar na aaiaa|

en.bdb: The story of that  unmanifest Lord is extremely mystical, indescribable and beyond all  thoughts.
Only gurmukhs can have a glimpse of Him.
